blocks.note: Exactly 3 blocks, in the fixed order pdp -> products -> video.

evidence.structure: Structure, layout and motion measured against the live original. A pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at a 1440px viewport and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas. Copy is the original's own.

constraints.verification: src/pages/Home.jsx:14 renders <AiSection /> third. Checked against all 5 real templates: it appears only in `home`, immediately after content.what-intro. It is ONE section element, not three, so onePerPage is correct.

productShots.count: 20 files: 2 theme pairs (4), 6 mobile tiles, 5 collage images + their 5 -upd cross-fade twins

motion.detail: All three h3 headings carry data-flash and run the m22 + m23 split-and-reveal sequence. public/motion/m28.js cross-fades the five .is-img-anima-1..5 twins on a 0.8-1.5s repeating loop. m27.js drives the three background videos and is the ONE place prefers-reduced-motion is genuinely honoured. The .ai__btn pill scales to 0.9 and turns accent.hover on hover.
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Render all three headings unsplit at text.primary; stop the image cross-fades on their base frame; leave the three background videos paused on their poster, which is what m27.js itself already does under prefers-reduced-motion.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: mixed - the heading and image-cross-fade parts are a design rule; the background-video part is mirrored (public/motion/m27.js genuinely reads prefers-reduced-motion for this slot)

responsive.base: block 1 shows the two-up .ai__grid; blocks 2 and 3 use the .ai__grid-small collage skeleton
responsive.max-767px: block 1 swaps the two-up grid for the six-tile .ai__grid-alt collage (a DIFFERENT element set, not a reflow); heading.sub drops to 1.5rem and body.default to 0.875rem

measuredFrom.quote: Upload one product and get all the angles

contentMaxWordsTotalNote: Set BETWEEN the measured real total and the maximum the per-field budgets allow, so the cap can actually reject an over-long instance instead of being unreachable. extraction/verify_all.py check [p] fails if any declared contentMaxWordsTotal becomes vacuous (>= the per-field maximum).
